summary: Iteration 2 - Vehicle Visit Session Management System. Full backend + frontend regression. 44/44 pytest backend tests pass (auth, visit sessions entry/exit immutability, multi-session, search by plate/phone/owner/customer_id, master detail + summary + analytics, sessions per range including custom, master PATCH, /visit-sessions status mapping, legacy /vehicles CRUD, dashboard stats using vehicle_masters count, analytics overview with stay_time block, /reports/export csv+xlsx+pdf, /visits/export per-vehicle + all-vehicles csv+xlsx+pdf, 401 unauth on all new endpoints). Frontend: topbar search UP21AB1234 auto-redirects to /vehicle/UP21AB1234 (single-match rule), vehicle detail page renders master info + 6 summary cards (today=4 visits, 4h 10m stay), 4 analytics pills, 6 range chips, Excel/PDF/CSV export buttons all successfully trigger downloads, visit history table shows exactly 4 rows for today with correct times (08:30->09:15 '45 Minutes' Completed), timeline tab renders 8 alternating entry/exit points, range change to '30d' reloads and shows 39 rows, /search page with UP21 auto-redirects to detail (single master), Vehicle Records table plate is Link that navigates to /vehicle/{plate}, Reports page 'Export Visit History' section triggers /api/visits/export downloads, Analytics page shows 4 new stay-time cards above tabs.

issues: Value renders as '—' when shortest_seconds is 0 (e.g. seed produced a completed session with sub-minute duration or 0 rounded). formatDurationShort treats <=0 as no data. Consider showing '<1m' or aggregating only sessions > 0.

Table lists one row per visit_session (500 rows) rather than unique vehicles, so the same plate appears many times. Each row's plate Link works and navigates to /vehicle/{plate} as required, but a deduplicated master-view or grouping might be more intuitive.
Still reads '© 2026 hyundai Car Showroom...' — 'hyundai' should be capitalised (reported in iteration_1, still open).

action_items: (Optional polish) Analytics 'Shortest Stay' shows '—'. Filter out zero-duration completed sessions in analytics_overview aggregation, or render '<1m' when shortest_seconds == 0.
(Optional polish) Vehicle Records page currently lists all sessions; a master-grouped view (with total_visits) may be more useful given the new session model.
(Optional) server.py analytics_overview 'monthly' loop still uses (now - timedelta(days=30*i)).replace(day=1) which can drift; consider dateutil.relativedelta.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py record_exit correctly closes only the LATEST active session (sort entry_time desc) and never mutates older sessions. Verified with test_exit_closes_latest_active_session_only.
server.py normalize_plate strips whitespace and uppercases — good; used consistently across entry/exit/search/master routes.
vehicle_masters has a unique index on vehicle_number (ensure_indexes) — prevents duplicate masters.

serialize_session_with_master maps status active->inside, completed->exited for backward-compat only in legacy /vehicles and /visit-sessions endpoints. New /vehicles/master/{plate}/sessions correctly returns raw 'active'/'completed'.
visits/export supports both per-vehicle and all-vehicles; Content-Disposition includes the plate for per-vehicle exports (verified).
analytics_overview stay_time aggregates only status='completed' with entry_time within last 180 days and duration_seconds != None — but does not exclude 0 durations, so shortest_seconds can be 0.
VehicleDetail.jsx toast on 404 navigates to /vehicles — good UX; loadDetail runs once and loadSessions reruns on range/customFrom/customTo changes.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (rewrote to cover all 24 new/changed endpoints — 44 tests)
seed_data_creation: Seed on startup creates ~23 vehicle_masters + hundreds of visit_sessions incl. exactly 4 today-sessions for UP21AB1234 with entry endings 08:30, 10:20, 13:45, 17:10 (verified). Tests create/clean up TEST_-prefixed entries which are left as extra history but do not affect showcase assertions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py (pytest -n auto, 44 tests, ~5s) is the current regression suite. Auth flow unchanged from iteration_1. Vehicle visit sessions are the new core: entry/exit are non-destructive, always create new session or close latest active. Showcase vehicle UP21AB1234 is a stable fixture — customer_id 'CUS-DEMO01', owner 'Aarav Malhotra', phone '+91 9876543210', 4 today sessions totalling 250 minutes (15000s). Frontend testids of interest are documented in the review request under other_misc_info and all are present and functional. RangeFilters custom uses from_/to query params in YYYY-MM-DD.
rca of the issue: No new issues found. iteration_1 ObjectId leak remains fixed.
